name: update-highlight
title: Update highlight
description: Marks a row, card or number that just changed with a tint that fades out, an "Updated" marker when motion is reduced and a polite message for screen readers.
docs: Hand it a changeKey: the value, a version or a timestamp. When the key changes, the element is tinted with the foreground colour and fades over duration (1500 ms). The first value is never marked unless skipFirst is false, and changes that land while it is fading restart the same highlight. Nothing is added inside the element, so asChild works on a table row (the tint is then drawn on its cells). Under reduced motion, or with reduceMotion, there is no fade: a small marker with label hangs on the top edge for a few seconds. Pass label or announce and a screen reader hears a polite message on every change; messages that arrive together are read as one.
